name: Arina Gull
source:
Arina Gull is rough, tough, and built for the kind of work most people would rather pretend does not exist. A member of the Court of Rats with a reputation for settling problems quickly, she serves as a lieutenant to Queenie, the Rat Queen, making sure orders are carried out without hesitation. She came up running with small-time crews, working muscle on street rackets and protection jobs, and earned her ink by proving she could handle herself no matter how bad things get.

[Edited from the in-game profile]
